Planning Commission
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 1, 2014
06:00 P.M.
ROLL CALL
Recommended Action:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES: March 04, 2014
AGENDA CHANGES *3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - MATTERS NOT ON THE AGENDA
PUBLIC HEARING ITEM
1.
PC4-072 - Valvista North, LLC A request for a Specific Plan Amendment to add and modify signage allowances in the North County Square Specific Plan.  This project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with Section 15301 of the CEQA Guidelines.
2.
PC8-252 - Family Dollar A request for a Special Use Permit to establish a bargain basement store at 1281 N. Santa Fe Avenue.  This project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with Section 15301 of the CEQA Guidelines.
3.
PC4-075 - City of Vista A request for a Specific Plan Amendment to modify the ancillary land use categories in Use Area B of the Vista Business Park Specific Plan. This project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with Section 15304 of the CEQA Guidelines.
ADJOURNMENT
